Incident Bot: [PAGER] model-serving-usw2 latency > 500ms (5m avg) - paging @DevOps Oncall

DevOps Oncall: ack - investigating, attaching logs

Maria G: noticed spike after a deploy? rolling back now :thinking_face:

AJ: can we route traffic to a fallback model? Suggest enabling routing policy to model-alpha-quantized in us-west-2

Sophia L: Support, need customer-facing language for Zendesk/Intercom. Draft below.

Nate (Support): Draft for Zendesk macro: 
```
Hi {{customer_name}},

Thanks for reporting this. We’re aware of elevated latency for inference in us-west-2 and are actively mitigating. Affected requests may see responses delayed or timeouts. We’ve routed traffic to a secondary model and applied a temporary rollback. We’ll update you by {{eta}}. Sorry for the disruption — we’ll follow up with root cause.

— Redwood Support
```

Casey H: Intercom quick-reply: `We're investigating increased response times in US-WEST-2. Engineers are mitigating; we'll update shortly.`

Maria G: Internal status page snippet (short):
`Incident: Elevated inference latency in us-west-2. Mitigation: routing to fallback model and rollback of recent deploy. Impact: degraded latency for subset of users. ETA next update in 20m.`

DevOps Oncall: Current actions:
- rollback deploy 2026-03-15-14:02 (in progress)
- enable fallback routing to model-alpha-quantized
- increase batch-window to 60ms for critical routes
- monitor 95th pct latency

Sophia L: Support checklist for agents (copyable):
1) Acknowledge ticket with macro "USW2_LATENCY_ACK"
2) Check customer request ID and ask for sample request if available
3) Apply temporary workaround: switch to region fallback if customer is multi-region
4) Escalate to Eng if >30 min with no improvement

Nate (Support): Macros to add:
- USW2_LATENCY_ACK:
`Hi {{customer_name}}, thanks — we're actively investigating elevated latency in US-West-2. We've queued this with our infra team and will update within 30 minutes.`

- USW2_WORKAROUND_INSTRUCTIONS:
`If possible, please retry your request using the us-east-1 endpoint (https://api.redwood.ai/us-east-1). For SDKs, set region='us-east-1'. We'll keep you posted.`

DevOps Oncall: Logs: attaching snippet
```
2026-03-15T14:03:10Z - model-serving-usw2 - 95th_latency=512ms - kernel_queue_full
2026-03-15T14:04:02Z - deploy 2026-03-15-14:02 - rollback_start
```

AJ: Rollback complete at 14:05. Latency trending down (95th -> 180ms).

Incident Bot: Update: severity -> degraded, incident state -> mitigated

Sophia L: Status page update (public):
`Title: Elevated inference latency in US-West-2 — Mitigated
Summary: We experienced increased latency for inference requests in the US-West-2 region due to a faulty deploy. Traffic was routed to a fallback model and the deploy was rolled back. Service performance is returning to normal. Impacted users may have seen delayed responses or timeouts between 14:02–14:05 UTC. We will follow up with a postmortem.`

Maria G: Handoff notes to next oncall (@Casey H): rollback done, monitor for 1h, contact support if any regressions.

Casey H: Got it — taking over. I'll patch macros and post status page update in 10m.

Nate (Support): Final agent script to close tickets once validated:
`We have mitigated the issue by rolling back the deploy and routing traffic to a fallback model. Please verify your requests and reopen if you see further issues. Thank you for your patience.` :thumbsup:

Maria G: Thanks team. Postmortem owner: AJ. ETA for postmortem draft 48h.

End."
